name: ICW "Wrestler of the Year" Award
epitaph: Presented on air at Season Beating's for its inaugural (1996) year; the recipient's own acceptance interview recaps his ICW World Title win at the fed's "ICW Blood Bowl" tournament.

bestowals.vote_detail: Presented in-ring by President Clark on Season Beating's (17 January 1997), the fed's own "inaugural year" for the award, to "StarFox" Curt Crane.
